dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're the Young Master's friends. How do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Please accept my apologies, but I have something to ask of you. Is this a good time?

choices.text: Well, we're well-acquainted by now. Just speak your mind.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Well, here's the situation: there's this friend of mine named Muning who often helps us in business matters.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: It's just that he wound up owing a small sum of Mora to the Yanshang Teahouse in recent days, leading to him asking our young master for help...

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: ...And the young master agreed without a second thought! Interest-free, if I might add. A most generous spirit... But best not one used while doing business, I fear.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, he was just doing a guy some justice. Isn't that a good thing?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Yes, of course... But as you can see, Young Master Xingqiu has gone out to "right wrongs and enact justice," while I'm a little tied up with work back here. As such, the only person we can trust with the matter of delivering the Mora is you.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: He should be working at The Chasm. He basically lives there, so I doubt you'll miss him.

choices.text: People actually still live at The Chasm?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Haha! Well, he is the specialist sent by the Ministry of Civil Affairs to the Chasm, after all!

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Of course, that is a mine, so food, water, and daily necessities all need to be transported there from Liyue...

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: So there isn't much time for idling or for leisure, and life can be both tough and a little boring, but regardless, the remuneration is quite generous indeed.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Well... You are the great hero of Liyue. Perhaps it might still be a bit of a tall order to ask for huge favors, but I'm sure some people might be willing to make small exceptions for you, yes?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: I believe that you'll be able to accomplish this task. If you do get stopped at the gates, though, come back here and we'll use some other methods instead.

choices.text: Well, I'll help for Xingqiu's sake.
No concerns that I'll just pocket the sum?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That's not something you say out loud!

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Hahahaha! Come now, there's no need for such jokes. I trust you.
